# PomodoFocus — Full Knowledge Base & Specifications

## Overview & Philosophy
PomodoFocus (hosted at https://pomodofocus.vercel.app) is an aesthetic, distraction-free Pomodoro timer designed for developers, students, researchers, designers, and remote professionals. The application marries Scandinavian design principles—uncluttered layouts, natural stone color palettes (#FAF9F6), and crisp typography—with the calming atmosphere of live lofi radio to foster uninterrupted flow state.

## Core Architecture & Technical Specifications
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router with Turbopack) & React 19
- **State Management**: Zustand with persistent local storage middleware
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom CSS variables (--primary: #FF6363, --background: #FAF9F6)
- **Audio Engine**: Native HTML5 Audio element with error-resilient stream buffering, automatic audio ducking on session alarm rings, and background playback resilience
- **Vector Graphics**: Single-path continuous SVG silhouette with C1 tangent-matched Bezier fillets for the liquid meniscus Dynamic Island droplet
- **Testing**: Vitest with unit test coverage across date utilities, timer logic, stats aggregation, task management, and audio store actions

## Built-In Radio Stations (Soundscapes)
1. **Lofi 24/7** (`lofi-radio`): Continuous relaxing lofi beats to study, code, and relax to. Stream: `https://play.streamafrica.net/lofiradio`
2. **Chillhop Radio** (`chillhop`): Jazzy instrumental hip hop curated for rhythm and focus. Stream: `https://streams.fluxfm.de/Chillhop/mp3-128/streams.fluxfm.de/`
3. **Smooth Chill** (`smooth-chill`): Melodic smooth jazz and ambient electronic soundscapes. Stream: `https://media-ssl.musicradio.com/SmoothChill`
4. **Coffee Shop Vibes** (`coffee-shop`): Cafe ambience blended with warm acoustic jazz. Stream: `https://ais-sa8.cdnstream1.com/3629_128.mp3`

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What makes PomodoFocus different from other Pomodoro timers?
Unlike conventional timer utilities that show intrusive advertisements or separate audio players, PomodoFocus seamlessly houses a 24/7 lofi streaming deck directly inside a dripping Dynamic Island vector navigation bar. It includes task estimation, session reflection ratings, interactive productivity heatmaps, and Document Picture-in-Picture without requiring a user account or paid tier.

### Is my data secure and private?
Yes. PomodoFocus operates on a local-first philosophy. All your tasks, custom duration presets, session ratings, and statistics are stored exclusively in your browser's localStorage. Zero cookies, zero third-party trackers, and zero backend databases are used.

### How do I use the Pomodoro Technique effectively?
1. Pick one task from your task list and estimate how many 25-minute Pomodoro sessions it will take.
2. Hit Space or click the start button. Let the ambient lofi station gently mask background distractions.
3. Commit to single-tasking for 25 minutes. If an unrelated thought arises, note it down on your task list and immediately return to your work.
4. When the bell chimes, step away from your workstation for 5 minutes.
5. After 4 cycles (100 minutes of deep focus), enjoy a longer 15-30 minute restorative break.

### Does PomodoFocus support Picture-in-Picture?
Yes. On Chromium-based browsers, clicking the Picture-in-Picture icon launches an always-on-top mini floating window displaying the countdown timer, active task, and pause/resume controls while you work across full-screen IDEs or documents.
